newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania August services up 7.0 percent.
newsitem.headline: Romania August services up 7.0 percent.

text.p: Romania's August commercial services rose 7.0 percent to 387.6 billion lei from the previous month in real terms, but were down 5.4 percent on year ago levels, the National Statistics Board (CNS) said on Tuesday.
CNS data showed eight-month services, worth 2.26 trillion lei, were up 1.3 percent from the year-ago period.
Data refer to services delivered mainly to the population and exclude transport, mail and telecoms.
The private sector took 72.7 percent of eight-month services, slightly up from 72.2 percent in the equivalent period of 1995. -- Luli Popescu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
